title: Add IC custom domain asset files for shivaritaglobal.com

requirements.summary: Add .well-known/ic-domains file in frontend/src with the specified custom domain value.
acceptanceCriteria: The file has no extension and is named exactly `ic-domains`.
The file content is exactly `"shivaritaglobal.com"` (including the quotes).

file_operations.description: Create `frontend/src/.well-known` if missing and add the `ic-domains` file (no extension) with exact content: "shivaritaglobal.com" (including quotes).

requirements.summary: Add ic-assets.json in frontend/src with the exact asset configuration to include .well-known.
acceptanceCriteria: The file content matches exactly the user-provided text: `[{"match":.well-known","ignore":false}]`.

file_operations.description: Create `frontend/src/ic-assets.json` with the exact contents `[{"match":.well-known","ignore":false}]` (match characters exactly as provided, including brackets/quotes).
